title: Surreal Mirror Fairy
description: A central woman with green fairy wings wears a mirrored disco-ball bodysuit and a flower crown, raising one hand. She stands in a chaotic surreal landscape featuring hellish red waterfalls with demons and melting apples on the left, a framed portal showing a boat on a cosmic waterfall on the right, and a green octopus holding an envelope beside a melting clock.
prompt: A woman with green fairy wings and a flower crown stands at the center wearing a reflective mirrored disco-ball bodysuit. She raises one hand in a surreal dreamscape. To the left, red demonic figures and melting apples with blood-like drips flow over fiery cliffs. To the right, a large framed portal reveals a boat on a glowing cosmic waterfall under a spiral galaxy. A green octopus holds a letter beside a melting clock. Floating eyes, jellyfish, and dragons fill the vibrant red and teal sky.
